findings.title: Extracted files show over-100% progress and lose completion indicators
findings.body: For local_size=20 and remote_size=10, the changed expression returns 200 instead of 100. The existing regression vectors in view-file.service.spec.ts explicitly require 100 for this case. transfer-row.component.html displays the raw percentage at line 28 and requires exactly 100 for success styling (line 33) and the 'Done' label (line 53). Its width clamp at line 35 protects only bar geometry: completed extracted files now display 200% and lose both completion indicators.
findings.recommendation: Restore Math.min(100, ...) around the calculated percentage and retain the existing extracted-file regression vectors.

next_steps: Restore the clamp and run the ViewFileService unit tests.
